scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && npm run docs:build
scripts.build:local: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode development --outDir .wrangler/dev-dist && node ../scripts/build-documentation.mjs --target=website --out-dir=.wrangler/dev-dist/docs
scripts.test: npm run test:demo && npm run test:downloads && node --import tsx --test server/**/*.test.ts && node --test build/*.test.mjs tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:downloads: node --import tsx --test tests/downloads.test.ts server/release-catalog.test.ts && node --test build/download-config.test.mjs build/product-release.test.mjs
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy
